lines: All 3 pages load the same 2 files: 2,219,561 B raw, 553,113 B gzip, 99.7 % of the smallest page (tasks-talk, 2,226,518 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 410,409 B, moment 293,131 B, @nextcloud/dialogs 202,820 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 141,709 B, @nextcloud/timezones 126,970 B.
moment, 293,131 B on the tasks-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,649 B on the tasks-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (69 packages, 575 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
